mapper.insert:
insert into grain_temp_record ( warehouse_id, point_id, collected_at, temperature_value, source_type, batch_no, quality_flag, remark, created_by ) values
( #{item.warehouseId}, #{item.pointId}, #{item.collectedAt}, #{item.temperatureValue}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.batchNo}, #{item.qualityFlag}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createdBy} )
on duplicate key update temperature_value = values(temperature_value), source_type = values(source_type), batch_no = values(batch_no), quality_flag = values(quality_flag), remark = values(remark), created_by = values(created_by)
mapper.select: select r.id as id, r.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, r.point_id as pointId, p.point_name as pointName, p.zone_code as zoneCode, p.layer_no as layerNo, p.point_no as pointNo, date_format(r.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as collectedAt, r.temperature_value as temperatureValue, r.source_type as sourceType, r.quality_flag as qualityFlag from grain_temp_record r join grain_temp_point p on r.point_id = p.id join warehouse w on r.warehouse_id = w.id where (#{warehouseId} is null or r.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) and (#{startTime} is null or r.collected_at >= #{startTime}) and (#{endTime} is null or r.collected_at <= #{endTime}) and (#{zoneCode} is null or #{zoneCode} = '' or p.zone_code = #{zoneCode}) and (#{layerNo} is null or p.layer_no = #{layerNo}) order by r.collected_at desc, p.layer_no asc, p.point_no asc
